sn52.6:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn52.6:1.3: katamesaṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ pattoti.
sn52.6:1.4: catunnaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.6:1.6: idhāhaṃ āvuso kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.6:1.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.6:1.10: imesaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.6:1.11: imesañca panāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sahassalokaṃ abhijānāmīti.
